name: mechanism_pilot
description: Six-arm mechanism pilot (E1 scaled_default, E2 frozen_reinit, E5 random_online beside default, confstream, frozen_prefix) on the 12 streams locked in docs/MECHANISM_PILOT.md, gate-free, sequential silhouette as the selection signal, stability and the end-of-window snapshot logged as diagnostics only. The two E4 oracle arms of MECHANISM_PILOT.md are not in this inventory; they can be added later as an extension under the same protocol.

operational.timeout_source: conf_pipeline/make_notebook.py, preset full (TIMEOUT_S = 12 * 3600), the timeout out/full ran under

decisions.HPStream: read through HPStreamStableLabels, run in its place: River's HPStream with labels never reused (RIVER_BUGS.md GAP-6), the same clusters and predictions at every point; decided by the user on 2026-11-04. River's HPStream stays registered and runnable; the campaign does not run both, as one model would count twice

excluded_arms.confstream_ari_oracle: E4 diagnostic; left out of this six-arm campaign, addable later under the same protocol
excluded_arms.confstream_ari_oracle_constrained: E4 diagnostic; left out of this six-arm campaign, addable later under the same protocol
